title: Audit hub NDJSON/CSV serializer and permissioned query snapshots
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Scope: Implement a production-ready export pipeline and UI for console audit queries that supports column-configurable CSV and NDJSON dumps, RBAC-aware redaction and permission checks (RBAC v2), saved query snapshots that can be revoked by admins, and efficient pagination/batching for large result sets.

Goals:
- Provide CSV and NDJSON serializations with deterministic field ordering and optional flattening for nested metadata, suitable for downstream ingestion.
- Ensure exports respect RBAC v2 permissions and field-level redaction rules; no PII or sensitive tokens should be included for roles without the necessary scope.
- Implement server-side cursored pagination with resumable export jobs to avoid client timeouts for exports > 100k rows.
- Offer "snapshots": immutable, time-stamped query+filter artifacts stored for auditability and reuse. Snapshots must be revocable by org admins and bound by retention policy.
- Add admin controls in Console to list active exports, revoke snapshots, and set per-org export size limits.
- Provide operator observability (metrics, logs, SLOs) and a job retry policy for transient backend failures.

Out of scope for this ticket: long-term cold storage (S3 lifecycle), end-user download throttling UI polish (handled in follow-up), and per-tenant billing integration.

Deliverables:
- Backend export API endpoints: POST /v1/audit/exports to start, GET /v1/audit/exports/{id} for status and cursor, GET /v1/audit/exports/{id}/download for finished artifact.
- NDJSON and CSV serializer modules with configurable column mapping and header templates.
- Snapshot model and admin revoke endpoint with event emission for audit trail.
- Console UX: column chooser, export configuration modal, snapshot manager (list + revoke).
- Integration tests covering RBAC v2 permutations for 6 example roles and field redaction cases.
- Ops playbook for export job failures and cancellation.
comments: 2025-11-05 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes attached. Decided to support NDJSON and CSV first; Parquet deferred. Need to confirm canonical field list with Security and Compliance.
2025-11-12 - Marco Hernandez: Implemented cursor store in redis with TTL and resume logic. Observed a 3x CPU spike when serializing 50k rows; will add streaming generator to reduce memory pressure.

2025-11-17 - Priya Menon (Security reviewer): Flagged potential leakage of 'session_token' field. Added rule: redact fields matching /token|secret|password/ by default unless role has 'audit:secrets:read'.
2025-11-24 - Marco Hernandez: Added server-side sampling option for orgs that request aggregate exports instead of full detail. Sampling is off by default and must be enabled by admin toggle.
2025-11-30 - UX review by Daniel Park: Column chooser UX updated to show field descriptions and RBAC-locked fields with lock icon and tooltip explaining why field is redacted.
2025-12-01 - Ops: Added retries with exponential backoff for transient S3/DB timeouts and a circuit breaker to prevent export job pileup during outages.
notes: Implementation must be audit-logged itself: export start/complete/fail events should be emitted to the audit stream with actor, snapshot id (if any), and row counts. Coordinate with RBAC v2 rollout team to reuse permission check libs. Plan can be split into two phases: minimal working export (NDJSON streaming + cursor) then advanced UX and snapshot revocation. Monitor CPU and memory during canary on staging using synthetic large exports. Also ensure timezone normalization (ISO8601) in timestamps inside exports.
acceptance_criteria: NDJSON and CSV exports can be initiated from Console and complete successfully for a 10k-row org test dataset
Exported artifacts contain no redacted fields for users with audit:full scope and have redactions for restricted roles
Cursored exports can resume after an interrupted job and produce identical output when resumed
Snapshots appear in Snapshot Manager with timestamps and can be revoked by an org admin
Integration tests for the 6 RBAC permutations pass in CI
